title: Kevin M NDE 3230
content: A spike in blood pressure caused a blood vessel to burst in my nose. I tried for several hours to get it to stop, but to no avail. I eventually had my wife take me to the local hospital, while waiting to get help; I started to go into shock. The triage nurse measured my blood pressure as (approximately) 170 over 120. When a doctor came to take me to an examination room, my legs gave out and was carried into the exam room. I remember nurses continually asking if I was still with them, and I thought, 'How absurd, of course I am still here.' I then found myself walking through a grassy field, the sun warm on my face, the trees off in the distance turning fall colors. The grass was about thigh high, but not difficult to walk through. I felt absolute happiness and peacefulness. I got the feeling that someone was just over the rise waiting for me. I then found myself back in that ugly green exam room with the doctors holding my legs up over my head and saying, 'He's back. We've got him.' I was so disappointed, almost angry to be back. I was only gone a few seconds.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness Life threatening event, but not clinical death . High blood pressure caused a nose bleed that would not stop.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness The whole time. It was just I was suddenly there, then suddenly back.
elements.At what time during the experience were: The whole time. It was just I was suddenly there, then suddenly back.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.The experience included: Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm A grassy field, bright sunny day, trees turning fall colors
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Mentioned it to doctors right away. Have told it to others, the reactions were ones of interest but that's about all.
